description: 0xSero's two-Spark SGLang profile for the LibertAIDAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint at the revision upstream hash-locks (9e0d74e3, the one its SGLang patches were written against; the repository's newer caca4e6a changed per-expert input scales and configuration and is not used), from glm-5.3-flash-sglang-sm121 at dfb1bb7e. Tensor and expert parallel 2 over the Spark fabric on 0xSero's published image (ghcr.io/0xsero/glm-5.3-flash-sglang-sm121, the digest the kit pins: upstream's six GLM/SGLang SM121 patches on the digest-pinned lmsysorg/sglang glm-5.3-flash image), run as published with only a thin layer for the Controller's launcher and not rebuilt from the kit's sources: DSA attention with flashinfer sparse MLA, FP8 E4M3 KV cache, flashinfer_cutlass MoE, NEXTN multi-token-prediction speculation (5 steps, 6 draft tokens, adaptive), image and video input, glm45 reasoning and glm47 tool parsing, CUDA graphs. Defaults are upstream's conservative tp2 profile (131072 tokens, 2 requests); upstream's tp4 profile (four Sparks) is not packaged. Upstream claims, not measured here: 17.49 tok/s at one request and 30.72 tok/s at two on two Sparks, 992128 KV tokens per rank. Licences are informational: the checkpoint is MIT; the source repository carries no licence file. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Chat template: the kit's with the standard enable_thinking switch on the generation prompt (<think></think> when a request turns thinking off, <think> otherwise), so the glm45 reasoning parser separates reasoning for requests that turn thinking off as well as for those that leave it on; the kit's template always opens <think>, SGLang then leaves the parser unforced for enable_thinking=false, and the end tag leaked into content (sweep 2026-11-03, smoke A391).
title: GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 SGLang two Sparks (0xSero)
